full_prompt_en: A square naturalistic oil painting looks upstream along a shallow woodland brook winding between moss-covered rocks into a misty autumn valley. The water begins in the lower left foreground as a dark, clear pool over visible amber-brown pebbles. Its narrow channel bends around a cluster of rounded boulders near the center and continues upward toward a pale opening in the middle distance. Several of the larger stones carry velvety green moss, especially a broad central boulder and a sloping rock at the lower right. Fine pale ripples catch light where the water breaks around their edges. Along the near right bank, soft green grass and small russet leaves grow among angular stones, then rise into a tawny, gently sloping hillside. On the left, a darker green bank supports tall trees with thin trunks and a canopy of ocher, brown, and muted gold leaves. Their branches arch inward from the upper left and form a loose frame around the brighter center. A second line of trees stands along the right side, where cooler teal-green foliage recedes into atmospheric haze. The brook remains visible as a string of small pale glints between the banks, drawing the eye deep into the picture. No person, animal, building, or readable mark interrupts the natural scene. The painted surface is fine but tactile: moss is softly granular, rocks have broken gray-brown edges, leaves gather into many small strokes, and the water alternates between transparent dark reflection and creamy highlights. Soft daylight appears to enter from the open upper center, illuminating the far valley and the right bank while the left foreground remains in tree shadow. The light is diffuse, leaving gentle contact shadows beneath the rocks rather than sharp cast bands. The overall composition is calm and gently winding, balancing warm autumn foliage with cool green moss and clear brown water as the stream recedes into luminous mist.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形自然主义油画沿浅浅的林间小溪向上游望去，溪水在长满青苔的石头之间蜿蜒，流向有薄雾的秋日山谷。水从左下前景开始，是一汪深而清的水潭，下方可见琥珀褐色卵石。狭窄水道绕过中央附近一组圆润巨石，继续向上延伸到中远景的浅色开口。几块较大石头带有绒绿苔藓，尤其是中央宽石和右下方倾斜的石块。水绕过它们边缘时，纤细浅色涟漪接住光。近处右岸，柔软绿草和小赤褐落叶长在棱角石头间，随后升成黄褐色缓坡。左侧，更深绿的岸上立着高树，纤细树干之上是赭黄、褐色和低调金色树冠。树枝从左上方向内拱过，松松地框住更亮的中央。右侧另有一列树，较冷的青绿色叶丛向大气薄雾中退远。溪水以一串浅色小亮点在两岸间保持可见，将目光带入画面深处。自然场景中没有人物、动物、建筑或可读标记。绘画表面细致却有触感：苔藓带柔颗粒，石头有破碎的灰褐边，叶片由许多短笔触聚成，水面则在透明深反光与奶油色亮点之间交替。柔和日光似乎从上方中央的林间开口进入，照亮远处山谷与右岸，左侧前景留在树影中。光漫散，石头下方只有轻柔接触阴影，而非锐利投影带。整体构图平静而轻轻蜿蜒，以暖秋叶平衡冷绿苔藓和清透褐水，让溪流退入发光的薄雾。
style_prompt_en: The naturalistic oil painting layers many small, tactile marks into an atmospheric landscape. Moss green, teal, amber-brown, muted gold, and gray stone tones share the frame without one flat dominant color. Rounded and angular surfaces alternate, while a broken reflective ribbon carries the eye through the scene. Soft light collects in distant openings and on selected wet edges; sheltered near passages hold deeper transparent browns. Leaves, fibrous growth, rock faces, and water receive distinct brush textures, with details gradually dissolving into mist as depth increases. Overhanging dark masses frame a lighter center, giving a gentle tunnel-like rhythm. The overall effect is tranquil and immersive, with subtle tonal depth and varied natural texture.
style_prompt_zh: 这种自然主义油画将许多细小、有触感的笔痕层叠成大气感空间。苔绿、青绿、琥珀褐、低调金色与灰石色共同占据画面，没有单一平涂主色。圆润和棱角表面交替，一条破碎反光色带引导视线穿过场景。柔光聚在远处开口与选定湿边，受遮蔽的近处区域保持较深且透明的褐色。叶片、纤维状生长物、岩面和水面各有不同笔触，细节随纵深增加逐渐溶入薄雾。上方悬垂的深色块框住较亮中央，带来温柔的隧道般节奏。整体效果宁静且有包围感，兼具微妙的明暗纵深与变化丰富的自然肌理。
theme_en: A mossy woodland stream running through autumn trees into mist
theme_zh: 长满青苔的林间溪流穿过秋树流向薄雾
name: Joseph Farquharson
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
